title: VTN Broadcasts — Send — payload
description: An administrator's message for every group registered for a role. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

role.description: The role to address: delivered to every current member's group registered for it.

class.description: What kind of message it is, for the receiving group to sort on: `notice` (the default), `request-for-action`, `room-invite`, or another the network's framework names.

replyTo.description: Where replies go, such as a URL or DID for a network data room, so that a broadcast never becomes reply-all.

Response.title: VTN Broadcasts — Send — response payload
Response.description: The broadcast as recorded, with each group's receipt as it stands when the network answers. Queued deliveries are retried from the outbox and update the record later.
